text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — final panel for SDE-IC candidate is tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Two asks: 1) who can cover as backup if Jordan gets delayed, and 2) confirm debrief format/length (short and sharp or full 20m?)

Jordan: I'm flying early AM, might be +15. If I'm not on time, happy to join for the last 10m of debrief. @Maya would you be OK scribeing if I miss the start?

Maya: Yep I can scribe. Quick clarification — do we want the candidate transcript attached to the notes or just a consent note? Last time there was confusion about attaching audio->transcript.

Sam: We ask for transcript consent at scheduling; calendar event should have the checkbox. If it's not set, we should ask at the top of the interview. Regarding debrief length: for IC roles I recommend 15m (tight bullets + score). For senior, 20–25m.

Priya: Good to know — this is IC so 15m works. For records: please use the lightweight rubric and the short note template below. If anyone prefers to add bullet examples, fine, but keep it brief.

Maya: Could you drop the template here? Also confirming the rubric link and whether we normalize scores this round (we ran into drift last hire).

Priya: Template pasted below — super small: 
```
1) Strengths (2 bullets)
2) Risks / Open questions (2 bullets)
3) Score (1-5)
4) Hire? (Yes/No/Maybe)
```
Rubric link: https://docs.redwood.ai/rubrics/swe-ic — we'll do a 15m calibration next week to normalize.

Sam: I'm +1 for a calibration. Suggest Wed 9:00 AM PT (short 30m). If that time blocks folks, record and I'll review async.

Jordan: Wed 9 works for me if travel doesn't wreck me. If not, I'll catch the recording.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder created — "Panel debrief & calibration" added to Everyone's calendar on 2024-07-17 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. :bell:

Priya: Awesome, thanks everyone. Recap: Maya scribing, debrief 15m, use the short template + rubric link above, ask for transcript consent at start if missing, calibration Wed 9. Ping here if you need to swap. :thumbsup:
